_meta.purpose: A SHARED PUBLIC catalogue of variants associated with longevity (rsID → gene/population/association/PMID). It contains nobody's genotypes. It is applied to a personal VCF by rsID, like loci.json.
_meta.note: The associations from the literature are of varying strength; many have not been reproduced and depend on the population. Use it as a research layer with caveats, not as a diagnosis.
